title: Failed turn state is never cleared and leaves trapped UI and stale storage
description: In EnabledWorkspace, turn.failed events are not cleaned up in the terminal event handler. The turn object is not reset, and sessionStorage keys for turn progress and last event ID persist indefinitely.

comments.author: box
comments.text:
Triage 2026-09-14 (Chatticus): CONFIRMED in code (not forced live — needs a failing turn).

In `EnabledWorkspace.startTurnStream`, terminal `turn.failed` sets `turnStatus` to `"failed"` via `turnStatusFromKind`, but only the `turn.completed` branch clears `turn` / progress / sessionStorage. Failed turns leave the Working bubble and failed header state stuck until channel switch (`selectItem` clears status).

Fix: on failed (and ideally on any terminal), clear or explicitly park the turn UI the same way as completed, and allow dismiss/retry.
